question: Can existing Harness close CPF-21 as the trusted Agent/Grant/Effect admission evidence source for Gateway capability authorization?

findings.authenticatedTransportBoundary: OfficialMcpClient supports private bearer file; local-service authentication is transport identity only.

harnessEvidenceAvailable: stable clientRequestId derived from Harness Run + step + ToolCall digest + ToolGrant digest
mismatch: Harness ToolGrant is assignment/tool authority and exact Run evidence; it is not the Security grant/agent credential/approval authority. Reinterpreting its digest as agentAdmission would launder authority across owners.

carrierDecision.futureCondition: A Security-owned issuer must create/normalize the admission evidence; Harness may transport an opaque or normalized Security-issued artifact over its authenticated local-service channel once provenance/integrity/currentness are explicit.

implementationDecision: Do not add speculative MCP meta/header fields now. No production Security issuer was found, so transport code without an issuer would create a caller-controlled authorization surface rather than close CPF-21.
